purpose: Describe an action as difficult to perform.
keywords: This writing is hard to read.
These shoes are difficult to walk in.
This bottle was hard to open.
restrictions: Often relates to a property of the object or circumstances; it conjugates as an い-adjective.
mistake: Use 読みにくい, not 読むにくい.

segments.role: Describe an action as difficult to perform. ます-stem + にくい.
